clauses.quote: Areas of concern regarding the complaint shall be discussed with the Teacher in private.
clauses.subject_text: Areas of concern regarding the complaint

clauses.quote: All matters relating to a complaint are to be kept confidential.
clauses.subject_text: All matters relating to a complaint

clauses.quote: Documents, communications, and records dealing with the complaint shall be placed in the Teacher’s personnel file.
clauses.subject_text: Documents, communications, and records dealing with the complaint

clauses.quote: all related documents and records will be returned to the Teacher within five working days.
The investigation and resolution of all complaints shall be completed within fifteen (15) calendar days
clauses.subject_text: The investigation and resolution of all complaints

clauses.quote: The Administrator investigating the complaint shall proceed in an impartial manner
The Administrator investigating the complaint shall objectively weigh all facts of the complaint prior to reaching a conclusion.

On or before the last school day in September, the WTU Building Representative shall notify the Supervisor of the dates during the school year when the SCAC and Local School Chapter will hold their regularly scheduled meetings.
The Supervisor shall include the Chapter and SCAC meeting dates and times in the local school calendar.
Local School Chapter Meetings shall be held during the lunch period or outside of normal school hours in a manner that will not interfere with the School’s instructional program.
Within 24 hours of each meeting, the WTU Building Representative shall notify the building Supervisor of the names of persons other than chapter Teachers or WTU officials who plan to attend.
